title: Enterprise ROI Engine Governance Manifest
description: Declarative governance manifest for the enterprise-roi-engine repository. Defines which organizations, environments, and roles can access CFO-grade financial impact artifacts, ROI calculations, and executive financial summaries. This manifest enforces strict separation between execution authority and visibility. It is purely declarative - no financial calculations, ERP abstractions, or business logic is embedded.

id.description: Unique ROI governance manifest identifier (UUID v4, immutable)

repository.description: Fixed repository identifier for ROI engine governance

organizationId.description: Organization that owns this governance manifest

description.description: Human-readable description of the ROI governance requirements

financialArtifactGovernance.description: Governance for access to financial artifacts and ROI outputs

executiveVisibility.description: Governance for CFO-grade financial summaries and executive dashboards

dataIntegrationGovernance.description: Governance for data integration with external financial systems

effectiveDate.description: Date when this governance becomes effective

expirationDate.description: Date when this governance expires (null for no expiration)

observedAt.description: When this governance state was observed

dataSource.description: Authoritative source of this governance data

artifactTypeAccess.description: Access grants organized by financial artifact type

defaultDeny.description: If true, access to financial artifacts is denied unless explicitly granted

sensitivityLevels.description: Defined sensitivity levels for financial data in this organization

auditRequirements.description: Audit logging requirements for financial artifact access

FinancialArtifactGovernance.description: Governance rules for financial artifact access

accessGrants.description: Access grants for this artifact type
